title: BeBox is a Haiku application that emulates Be Inc.'s BeBox
summary: BeBox is a Haiku OS application that faithfully emulates Be Inc.'s original BeBox, a groundbreaking dual-processor computer from the 1990s. The project preserves computing history by allowing users to experience the vintage BeBox environment on modern hardware.
problem_solved: It preserves and recreates access to the historic BeBox computing experience that would otherwise be lost to hardware obsolescence.
why_valuable: This project serves as an important bridge between computing history and modern users, allowing retrocomputing enthusiasts to experience Be Inc.'s innovative dual-processor architecture on contemporary systems.
